flora: Grove of mature Brachyphyllum (bushy, medium-height trees with drooping, rope-like branches)
Meandering river channel in the background
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; dense and bushy 'hedge' appearance; soft, drooping branch silhouettes; vibrant Jurassic forest atmosphere.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view of a Jurassic river forest. Brachyphyllum trees form a dense, green thicket on a red-brown mudstone bank. Their thick, scaly branches hang slightly toward the ground. In the background, the river reflects the ochre sky.
visual_logic.ground: Rich red-brown soil covered in fallen green scales and patches of moss.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm sunlight filtering through a high canopy, creating soft dappled light on the unique rope-like foliage of the Brachyphyllum grove.
